subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes. 

State, District, Colony
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :

 
• All Colony are part of a District.
 
• All Districts are part of State.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e5717b0ebdf7811c1273f868b8d7f1a561454b766eaae74714b7234d4baca8a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
